result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The causal clause beginning “Since” directly identifies Uzziah’s livestock as the reason he dug the cisterns. The later statement about loving the soil instead explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers, so it is not an equally defensible answer. The edit preserves the intended question about his reason for digging cisterns while correcting the key.
